component.name: Zimanyar
component.summary: Check and learn Kurdish as you write

description.p: Zimanyar finds mistakes in Sorani and Kurmanji as you write, explains each one, and teaches the grammar behind it. Everything runs on your own computer, and nothing is ever sent anywhere.

ul.li: Spelling, letter and grammar checks, including ergativity in the past tense
A reason, examples and a lesson for every finding
Two full courses of 23 lessons, with verb and noun tables
Check the clipboard from anywhere with a keyboard shortcut
Open and save text and Markdown files
